subject.title: refactor(protocol): pre-publish cheat-window cleanup and vintage tracking

question: Should the repository accept this intentional pre-publication/beta compatibility break for `question.*` and session-catalog plugin-SDK shapes without a compatibility or doctor-migration path?
rationale: The branch removes and renames externally consumable protocol fields; source-level correctness cannot establish whether the stated unshipped/beta-only surface audit is the intended permanent release policy.

options.title: Accept the compatibility window
options.body: Confirm that these protocol and plugin-SDK shapes have no supported shipped contract, then merge after proof and CI validation complete.

options.title: Preserve a transition contract
options.body: Keep the former fields or add a documented migration/deprecation path for any beta or external consumer maintainers want to support.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Separate the compatibility-sensitive reshapes from the vintage and dead-surface cleanup until the contract decision is recorded.

recommendation.title: Accept the compatibility window
recommendation.body: Confirm that these protocol and plugin-SDK shapes have no supported shipped contract, then merge after proof and CI validation complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history ties this contributor to the proposed protocol and release-vintage policy changes, although an additional repository owner should confirm the contract decision.
